name: Moth Tea
source:
Moth Tea is an 18+ story-driven visual novel full of emotion, romance, and a woman turning into a moth and working at a maid cafe. Nothing ever bad happens to her and she's surrounded by friends that love and protect her.

[From [url=https://cinswitch.itch.io/moth-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《蛾茶》是一部18+ 故事驱动的视觉小说，充满情感、浪漫，讲述了一个女人变成一只蛾并在女仆咖啡馆工作的故事。她没有发生过任何不好的事情，她周围都是爱她、保护她的朋友。

[来自[url=https://cinswitch.itch.io/moth-tea]Itch.io[/url]]
